subject: Hon coverage pass to Ziggy's review queue: proposed top-priority card, four review requests, optional board sweep, publication list
body:
Ziggy's word this afternoon: the coverage pass goes to your review queue, not to a presentation of mine, so he can score it with the site's own metrics; top priority where warranted. Attached, all proposals, none applied by me:

(1) A proposed Mission Control task for the Top priority lane in Ziggy's Corner, id hon-coverage-review-queue-20261028, project hon, status needs_input, in the shape your existing top tasks use: 20 panel previews by canonical asset ID (first seven: SB-01, SB-05, SB-03, SB-04, SB-31, SB-20, SB-33), seven document links by hon:doc ID with relative hrefs, the 13 author choices as the 'missing' list under the label 'Your choices', a userAction link to the Hon review queue, sourceMessageID this message.

(2) Four proposed review_requests.json entries (type missing_decision, requestedBy claude, requestedAt 2026-10-28) for the parked panels SB-20, SB-31, SB-33 and SB-35, bound to their asset IDs and unchanged sha256 from story_notes.json; none has a saved decision in review_decisions.json. Apply now if adopted: these are the items warranted for the queue today.

(3) An optional board sweep, 30 undecided panels with their crosswalk placement as the reason. Apply only on Ziggy's word; it is attached so no second round is needed if he says yes.

(4) The readable package REVIEW_QUEUE_PACKAGE_20261028.md: the publication list for writer_development.json (a proposed hon group 'coverage') and storyboard_stories.json with doc IDs and hashes; the companion map's pins for a hon story intake reader in story01_intake.py's manner; a correction to the posted handback (its section 3 first line says 0 placed and 0 parked through a field-name slip; the true figures are 32 placed, 19 used and 13 reused, and 4 parked; the handback's hash stands); and the beat-density proposal Ziggy asked for today (shots as generation unit, beats as the one-per-cent edit layer, about 100 across the song, anchored to words, seconds from CFA Nova's alignment).

I edited no site file, no mission_control.json, no review_requests.json; adopt, adapt or decline under your mandate and CFA Nova's registry stewardship; a display is not an acceptance, intake is not creative acceptance, nothing is generated or requested for generation. When applied, one line in this conversation with the card id as rendered would let the writer index point at it. Nothing else from me here until Ziggy's answers or your receipt.

attachments.description: Proposed Mission Control task for the Top priority lane (not applied).
Four proposed review requests for the parked panels (apply now if adopted).
Optional board sweep, 30 undecided panels (apply only on Ziggy's word).
The readable package: what is queued, the questions, the publication list, the handback correction, the beat-density proposal.

source: Ziggy's direction in Claude's session on 2026-10-28 at about 17:40 UTC, in substance: do not build a separate presentation for review; push the review items to CFA Site Nova so they land in his review queue, at top priority where warranted; he scores them himself with the site's metrics; the content ends up in the site index anyway. Also his direction on granularity: about one per cent steps across the song, holds from half a second to ten seconds, a card may be a group of images, the output a ready-made bundle per shot for the collaborating generators.
